question: Does optimizing pair actuator values improve over risk-scored motif selection with a fixed within-motif value cycle?
primary_gate: ratio of mean risk_pair error to fixed-value risk-motif error below 0.80 and upper endpoint of two-sided 95% paired t interval for risk_pair minus fixed-value control below zero
secondary_context: Report factorial-hub, coverage-pair and balanced-risk means; these do not override the primary gate.
interpretation: A pass supports optimizing actuator values given the risk-scored motif rule in this synthetic family. A failure does not prove equality. The two policies may traverse different motifs after their posteriors diverge.
resource: 80 local numerical systems; no GPU or closed-source model calls. Archive all cells and hashes even if the gate fails.
forbidden: Do not alter rule, simulator, learner, seeds, cost, endpoint or gate after seeing outcomes.
